zh: 窗户被风吹开了。
py: chuāng hu bèi fēng chuī kāi le
en: The window was blown open by the wind.
why: Doer 风 follows 被, and the verb carries the result 开 plus 了. The 被 phrase must come before the verb.

zh: 我的电脑被弟弟弄坏了。
py: wǒ de diàn nǎo bèi dì di nòng huài le
en: My computer was broken by my little brother.
why: Receiver first, then 被 + doer, then the verb with its result. 弟弟 cannot go after 弄坏了 the way English puts 'by my brother' at the end.

s: 我的电脑没被病毒感染。
s_py: wǒ de diàn nǎo méi bèi bìng dú gǎn rǎn
zh: 我的电脑没被病毒感染。
py: wǒ de diàn nǎo méi bèi bìng dú gǎn rǎn
en: My computer wasn't infected by a virus.
why: 没 before 被 is correct, and with 没 there is no 了. The two-syllable verb 感染 can stand alone here.

s_py: nǐ bèi lǎo shī huì fā xiàn de
zh: 你会被老师发现的。
py: nǐ huì bèi lǎo shī fā xiàn de
en: The teacher will catch you.
why: Modal 会 goes before 被, not after the doer.

src: 网络已经被修好了。
src_py: wǎng luò yǐ jīng bèi xiū hǎo le
task: Say it naturally, with no 被.
zh: 网络已经修好了。
py: wǎng luò yǐ jīng xiū hǎo le
en: The network has already been fixed.
why: When you only report that a thing is now fixed, no 被 is needed. 已经 stays before the verb.

s: 同学被我的词典借走了。
s_py: tóng xué bèi wǒ de cí diǎn jiè zǒu le
zh: 我的词典被同学借走了。
py: wǒ de cí diǎn bèi tóng xué jiè zǒu le
en: My dictionary was borrowed by a classmate.
why: The receiver comes before 被 and the doer after it. Here they are swapped, so the dictionary borrowed the classmate.

q: 我的药___弟弟吃光了，现在得再去买。
zh: 我的药让弟弟吃光了，现在得再去买。
py: wǒ de yào ràng dì di chī guāng le xiàn zài děi zài qù mǎi
en: My little brother ate up all my medicine, so I have to buy more now.
why: 让 + doer 弟弟 + result 光 makes the passive. 把 would turn the medicine into the one eating, and 向 or 对 do not introduce a doer.

s_py: tā bù bèi dà jiā lǐ jiě
zh: 他不被大家理解。
py: tā bù bèi dà jiā lǐ jiě
en: He isn't understood by anyone.
why: 不 before 被 is fine for a general state like this one, and the two-syllable verb 理解 can stand bare. Only a single past event needs 没.

s_py: wǒ de diàn nǎo jiào tōu zǒu le
zh: 我的电脑叫人偷走了。
py: wǒ de diàn nǎo jiào rén tōu zǒu le
en: Someone stole my computer.
why: 叫 must be followed by a doer, even if only 人. Only 被 can go straight before the verb.

q: 我的电脑___偷了，里面有我的作业。
zh: 我的电脑被偷了，里面有我的作业。
py: wǒ de diàn nǎo bèi tōu le lǐ miàn yǒu wǒ de zuò yè
en: My computer was stolen, and my homework was on it.
why: No doer is named, and only 被 can stand directly in front of the verb. 叫 and 让 need a doer after them, and 把 needs an object.

q: 我的手机___妈妈收走了，一个星期后才还给我。
zh: 我的手机被妈妈收走了，一个星期后才还给我。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi mā ma shōu zǒu le yí gè xīng qī hòu cái huán gěi wǒ
en: My phone was confiscated by Mom, and I only got it back a week later.
why: The phone is the receiver and Mom the doer, so 被 comes between them. 把 would make the phone the confiscator.

q: 我的手机___小偷偷走了。
zh: 我的手机被小偷偷走了。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi xiǎo tōu tōu zǒu le
en: My phone was stolen by a thief.
why: The thief is the doer, so 被 sits right before 小偷 and the phone, the receiver, comes first. 把 would turn the phone into the one doing the stealing.

src: 你的电脑被病毒感染了。
src_py: nǐ de diàn nǎo bèi bìng dú gǎn rǎn le
zh: 你的电脑可能会被病毒感染。
py: nǐ de diàn nǎo kě néng huì bèi bìng dú gǎn rǎn
en: Your computer might get infected by a virus.
why: 可能 and 会 go before 被 as a block. 了 is dropped because the event has not happened.

src: 我的照片被别人转发了。
src_py: wǒ de zhào piàn bèi bié rén zhuǎn fā le
zh: 我的照片让别人转发了。
py: wǒ de zhào piàn ràng bié rén zhuǎn fā le
en: My photo was forwarded by other people.
why: 让 takes the place of 被 and the doer 别人 is kept before the verb.

q: 他没___病毒感染，是因为一直开着杀毒软件。
zh: 他没被病毒感染，是因为一直开着杀毒软件。
py: tā méi bèi bìng dú gǎn rǎn shì yīn wèi yì zhí kāi zhe shā dú ruǎn jiàn
en: He wasn't infected by the virus because he always kept antivirus software running.
why: 没 goes before 被, and 病毒 is the doer. 把 would say he did not infect the virus, which reverses the roles.

src: 孩子的手机被爸爸收走了。
src_py: hái zi de shǒu jī bèi bà ba shōu zǒu le
zh: 爸爸把孩子的手机收走了。
py: bà ba bǎ hái zi de shǒu jī shōu zǒu le
en: Dad took away the child's phone.
why: The doer 爸爸 becomes the subject and the receiver follows 把. Everything from the verb on is unchanged.

zh: 药被妈妈放在桌子上了。
py: yào bèi mā ma fàng zài zhuō zi shang le
en: The medicine was put on the table by Mom.
why: The doer 妈妈 sits between 被 and the verb phrase, and 放在桌子上 stays together with 了 after it. Putting 妈妈 at the end is the English order.

zh: 他的伤口被医生处理得很干净。
py: tā de shāng kǒu bèi yī shēng chǔ lǐ de hěn gān jìng
en: His wound was cleaned up well by the doctor.
why: 被 + 医生 comes before the verb, and 得 + description follows it. Adding the doer after the description is the English order.

src: 他被撞倒了。
src_py: tā bèi zhuàng dǎo le
zh: 他被车撞倒了。
py: tā bèi chē zhuàng dǎo le
en: He was knocked down by a car.
why: The doer goes between 被 and the verb, not at the end after 了.

src: 作业已经被写完了。
src_py: zuò yè yǐ jīng bèi xiě wán le
task: Say it naturally, with no 被.
zh: 作业已经写完了。
py: zuò yè yǐ jīng xiě wán le
en: The homework is already done.
why: Homework cannot act and no doer is named. Chinese reports the result with no 被.

src: 我的药被弟弟吃完了。
src_py: wǒ de yào bèi dì di chī wán le
zh: 弟弟把我的药吃完了。
py: dì di bǎ wǒ de yào chī wán le
en: My little brother finished off my medicine.
why: Turn the doer into the subject and move the receiver after 把; the verb 吃完了 stays exactly as it was.

q: 还好，我的手机___被弟弟摔坏。
zh: 还好，我的手机没被弟弟摔坏。
py: hái hǎo wǒ de shǒu jī méi bèi dì di shuāi huài
en: Luckily my phone didn't get dropped and broken by my little brother.
why: One past event that did not happen is negated with 没 placed before 被. 不 is for habits, 别 is a command, and 会 would say it will happen.

src: 我的电脑没被同事用坏。
src_py: wǒ de diàn nǎo méi bèi tóng shì yòng huài
zh: 同事没把我的电脑用坏。
py: tóng shì méi bǎ wǒ de diàn nǎo yòng huài
en: My colleague didn't ruin my computer by using it.
why: The doer 同事 becomes the subject, 没 stays before the marker, now 把, and the receiver follows 把.

zh: 我的耳机被人拿走了。
py: wǒ de ěr jī bèi rén ná zǒu le
en: Someone took my earphones.
why: 人 stands for an unknown doer and stays between 被 and the verb. 被人 is the usual way to say 'someone did it'.

q: 你的体检报告已经___打印好了，在前台。
zh: 你的体检报告已经打印好了，在前台。
py: nǐ de tǐ jiǎn bào gào yǐ jīng dǎ yìn hǎo le zài qián tái
en: Your checkup report has been printed; it's at the front desk.
why: The report is a thing, no doer is named and nothing bad happened, so the plain 'thing + result + 了' is natural. 被 would feel heavy and unnatural.

src: 小偷把他的手机偷走了。
src_py: xiǎo tōu bǎ tā de shǒu jī tōu zǒu le
zh: 他的手机被小偷偷走了。
py: tā de shǒu jī bèi xiǎo tōu tōu zǒu le
en: The thief stole his phone.
why: The phone goes first, the thief follows 被, and 偷走了 is copied over. Do not leave 把 behind.

q: 小声点儿，___被老师发现了。
zh: 小声点儿，别被老师发现了。
py: xiǎo shēng diǎn r bié bèi lǎo shī fā xiàn le
en: Keep your voice down, don't let the teacher catch us.
why: To warn someone, put 别 before 被. 没 or 已经 would report a fact, which does not fit a warning to keep quiet.

zh: 你别被陌生人骗了。
py: nǐ bié bèi mò shēng rén piàn le
en: Don't let strangers fool you.
why: A warning puts 别 before 被, then the doer 陌生人, then the verb. 别 cannot come after the doer.

q: 我的电脑没___他弄坏，是我自己弄坏的。
zh: 我的电脑没被他弄坏，是我自己弄坏的。
py: wǒ de diàn nǎo méi bèi tā nòng huài shì wǒ zì jǐ nòng huài de
en: My computer wasn't broken by him; I broke it myself.
why: The computer is the receiver, so 没 + 被 + 他 + 弄坏. 把 would make the computer the doer that did not break him, which makes no sense.

s: 这种病毒不会被杀毒软件发现。
s_py: zhè zhǒng bìng dú bú huì bèi shā dú ruǎn jiàn fā xiàn
zh: 这种病毒不会被杀毒软件发现。
py: zhè zhǒng bìng dú bú huì bèi shā dú ruǎn jiàn fā xiàn
en: This kind of virus won't be detected by antivirus software.
why: 不会 goes before 被, and after a modal a two-syllable verb like 发现 can stand without 了 or a result.

src: 医生检查完了他的眼睛。
src_py: yī shēng jiǎn chá wán le tā de yǎn jing
task: Make 他的眼睛 the subject with 被.
zh: 他的眼睛被医生检查完了。
py: tā de yǎn jing bèi yī shēng jiǎn chá wán le
en: The doctor finished examining his eyes.
why: The receiver comes first and 医生 follows 被. 检查完了 carries the result so the verb is not bare.

src: 我的手机被同学借走了。
src_py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi tóng xué jiè zǒu le
zh: 我的手机叫同学借走了。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī jiào tóng xué jiè zǒu le
en: My phone was borrowed by a classmate.
why: 叫 replaces 被 in the same slot, with the doer 同学 still required right after it.

zh: 我的眼镜被妹妹踩坏了。
py: wǒ de yǎn jìng bèi mèi mei cǎi huài le
en: My glasses were stepped on and broken by my little sister.
why: Receiver, then 被 + doer, then the verb with its result. Once the object is in front there is no 把.

src: 我们被老师发现了。
src_py: wǒ men bèi lǎo shī fā xiàn le
zh: 我们没被老师发现。
py: wǒ men méi bèi lǎo shī fā xiàn
en: We weren't found out by the teacher.
why: 没 sits in front of 被, not before the verb, and 了 is dropped.

s_py: wǒ de chōng diàn bǎo ràng jiè zǒu le
zh: 我的充电宝让人借走了。
py: wǒ de chōng diàn bǎo ràng rén jiè zǒu le
en: Someone borrowed my power bank.
why: 让 used as a passive marker must be followed by a doer. Without 人 or a name, 让 has nobody to be the doer.

s: 我被蚊子咬得睡不着觉。
s_py: wǒ bèi wén zi yǎo de shuì bù zháo jiào
zh: 我被蚊子咬得睡不着觉。
py: wǒ bèi wén zi yǎo de shuì bù zháo jiào
en: I was bitten by mosquitoes so badly I couldn't sleep.
why: 咬得 + description is a valid way to give the result of the verb in a 被 sentence, so nothing is missing.

src: 妈妈关掉了我的电脑。
src_py: mā ma guān diào le wǒ de diàn nǎo
task: Make 我的电脑 the subject with 被.
zh: 我的电脑被妈妈关掉了。
py: wǒ de diàn nǎo bèi mā ma guān diào le
en: Mom switched off my computer.
why: Move the object to the front, put the doer after 被, and keep the result 掉 and 了 on the verb.

s_py: tāng zuò hǎo le kuài lái hē ba
zh: 汤做好了，快来喝吧。
py: tāng zuò hǎo le kuài lái hē ba
en: The soup is ready, come and drink it.
why: Soup cannot cook itself and nothing bad happened, so there is no 被. The sentence is already passive in meaning.

src: 我的检查结果没被医生弄错。
src_py: wǒ de jiǎn chá jié guǒ méi bèi yī shēng nòng cuò
zh: 医生没把我的检查结果弄错。
py: yī shēng méi bǎ wǒ de jiǎn chá jié guǒ nòng cuò
en: The doctor didn't get my test results wrong.
why: The doctor becomes the subject, 没 stays before the marker, now 把, and the verb phrase 弄错 is unchanged.

zh: 你上课玩手机会被老师批评的。
py: nǐ shàng kè wán shǒu jī huì bèi lǎo shī pī píng de
en: You'll get criticised by the teacher if you play on your phone in class.
why: Modal 会 goes before 被, not after the doer. 被老师会批评 is the classic mistake.

q: 医生说你的伤口已经___处理好了，不用担心。
zh: 医生说你的伤口已经处理好了，不用担心。
py: yī shēng shuō nǐ de shāng kǒu yǐ jīng chǔ lǐ hǎo le bú yòng dān xīn
en: The doctor says your wound has been taken care of, so don't worry.
why: With no doer named and good news, a plain 'thing + result + 了' is the natural way to say the wound has been dealt with. 被 suggests something was done to it.

s_py: tā de shǒu bèi dāo huá
zh: 他的手被刀划破了。
py: tā de shǒu bèi dāo huá pò le
en: His hand was cut by a knife.
why: 划 is bare here and cannot end the sentence. It needs a result such as 破 plus 了.

zh: 他被感冒折磨得睡不着觉。
py: tā bèi gǎn mào zhé mó de shuì bù zháo jiào
en: He was tormented by his cold so badly that he couldn't sleep.
why: The state left behind is described with 得 after the verb. 被感冒 precedes 折磨得, and the description comes last.

src: 他被我传染了。
src_py: tā bèi wǒ chuán rǎn le
zh: 他没被我传染。
py: tā méi bèi wǒ chuán rǎn
en: He wasn't infected by me.
why: Past negation uses 没 before 被, and 了 is removed. 被没我传染 is the wrong place for 没.

zh: 他的病情已经被医生控制住了。
py: tā de bìng qíng yǐ jīng bèi yī shēng kòng zhì zhù le
en: His condition has already been brought under control by the doctors.
why: The adverb 已经 goes before 被. 被医生已经控制住了 puts it in the wrong slot.

q: 手机的电已经___用完了。
zh: 手机的电已经用完了。
py: shǒu jī de diàn yǐ jīng yòng wán le
en: The phone's battery has already run out.
why: The battery is a thing that cannot act and no doer matters, so Chinese just reports the result. 被 here would sound odd, as if someone had used it up on purpose.

src: 你被网上的广告骗了。
src_py: nǐ bèi wǎng shàng de guǎng gào piàn le
task: Tell the person not to let it happen.
zh: 别被网上的广告骗了。
py: bié bèi wǎng shàng de guǎng gào piàn le
en: Don't be fooled by online ads.
why: 别 goes before 被 and the subject 你 is dropped in a command. 了 stays here to mean 'don't end up fooled'.

q: 我的耳机被弟弟弄___了。
zh: 我的耳机被弟弟弄坏了。
py: wǒ de ěr jī bèi dì di nòng huài le
en: My earphones got broken by my little brother.
why: 弄 cannot end the sentence alone; it needs a result, and 坏 gives 'broken'. 弄去 is not a word, and 过 or 着 would not give the broken result.

src: 妈妈把我的感冒药扔了。
src_py: mā ma bǎ wǒ de gǎn mào yào rēng le
zh: 我的感冒药被妈妈扔了。
py: wǒ de gǎn mào yào bèi mā ma rēng le
en: Mom threw away my cold medicine.
why: Swap the nouns around 被, delete 把, and keep 扔了. 了 is what lets this one-syllable verb end the sentence.

s_py: yào bèi mā ma rēng
zh: 药被妈妈扔了。
py: yào bèi mā ma rēng le
en: The medicine was thrown away by Mom.
why: A one-syllable verb cannot end a 被 sentence bare. It needs 了 or a result.

src: 小王把我的手机摔坏了。
src_py: xiǎo wáng bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī shuāi huài le
zh: 我的手机被小王摔坏了。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi xiǎo wáng shuāi huài le
en: Xiao Wang dropped and broke my phone.
why: Move the 把 object to the front, put the old subject after 被, and keep the verb with its result and 了 unchanged.

src: 他被同学们误会了。
src_py: tā bèi tóng xué men wù huì le
task: Say it won't happen, ending with 的.
zh: 他不会被同学们误会的。
py: tā bù huì bèi tóng xué men wù huì de
en: His classmates won't misunderstand him.
why: 不会 goes before 被 for a prediction, and 的 replaces 了. The two-syllable verb 误会 can stand bare after a modal.

src: 我的手机被偷走了。
src_py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi tōu zǒu le
zh: 我的手机没被偷走。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī méi bèi tōu zǒu
en: My phone wasn't stolen.
why: 没 goes before 被, and the final 了 is dropped because 没 already says it did not happen.

q: 昨天很多用户的账号___盗了，公司正在调查。
zh: 昨天很多用户的账号被盗了，公司正在调查。
py: zuó tiān hěn duō yòng hù de zhàng hào bèi dào le gōng sī zhèng zài diào chá
en: Many users' accounts were hacked yesterday, and the company is investigating.
why: No hacker is named, and only 被 can stand directly before 盗 without a doer. 让 and 叫 need a doer after them.

s_py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi tōu le
zh: 我的手机被偷了。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi tōu le
en: My phone was stolen.
why: 被 may be followed directly by the verb when the doer is unknown, and 了 completes it.

zh: 感冒药已经吃完了。
py: gǎn mào yào yǐ jīng chī wán le
en: The cold medicine is all gone.
why: A thing plus a result needs no 被 when nothing bad is being described. The extra tile 被 would make it sound odd.

zh: 我的充电器叫同学借走了。
py: wǒ de chōng diàn qì jiào tóng xué jiè zǒu le
en: My charger was borrowed by a classmate.
why: In the spoken passive 叫 takes the place of 被, and the doer 同学 must follow it directly before the verb.

src: 狗咬了我的手。
src_py: gǒu yǎo le wǒ de shǒu
task: Make 我的手 the subject with 被.
zh: 我的手被狗咬了。
py: wǒ de shǒu bèi gǒu yǎo le
en: The dog bit my hand.
why: The receiver 我的手 goes first and 被 + 狗 comes before the verb. 咬 needs 了 to end the sentence.

src: 弟弟把我的饮料喝光了。
src_py: dì di bǎ wǒ de yǐn liào hē guāng le
zh: 我的饮料叫弟弟喝光了。
py: wǒ de yǐn liào jiào dì di hē guāng le
en: My little brother drank up all my drink.
why: The 把 object goes first, 叫 + the old subject follow, and 喝光了 is unchanged. 把 is deleted.

s: 我的耳机拿走了被同学。
s_py: wǒ de ěr jī ná zǒu le bèi tóng xué
zh: 我的耳机被同学拿走了。
py: wǒ de ěr jī bèi tóng xué ná zǒu le
en: My earphones were taken by a classmate.
why: 被 + doer must come before the verb. Putting 'by the classmate' after the verb copies English.

zh: 那台平板电脑没被弟弟摔坏。
py: nà tái píng bǎn diàn nǎo méi bèi dì di shuāi huài
en: That tablet wasn't broken by my little brother.
why: As with 把, the negative 没 goes before 被, and the verb phrase 摔坏 stays unchanged at the end without 了.

src: 医生会把你的病治好的。
src_py: yī shēng huì bǎ nǐ de bìng zhì hǎo de
zh: 你的病会被医生治好的。
py: nǐ de bìng huì bèi yī shēng zhì hǎo de
en: The doctor will cure your illness.
why: The modal 会 stays before the marker, which is now 被, and the receiver 你的病 moves to the front.

zh: 他的腿被自行车撞伤了。
py: tā de tuǐ bèi zì xíng chē zhuàng shāng le
en: His leg was hurt when a bicycle hit him.
why: 撞 needs the result 伤, and the doer 自行车 goes right after 被, not after the verb.

zh: 我的账号昨天被盗了。
py: wǒ de zhàng hào zuó tiān bèi dào le
en: My account was hacked yesterday.
why: With no doer, 被 goes directly before the verb 盗. The time word can come before the receiver or right after it, but not after 被.

src: 我的手机被别人拿走了。
src_py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi bié rén ná zǒu le
zh: 我的手机被人拿走了。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi rén ná zǒu le
en: Someone took my phone.
why: 人 replaces the named doer as 'someone' and still sits between 被 and the verb.

q: 只要备份了，你的文件就___被删除。
zh: 只要备份了，你的文件就不会被删除。
py: zhǐ yào bèi fèn le nǐ de wén jiàn jiù bù huì bèi shān chú
en: As long as you've made a backup, your files won't be deleted.
why: A prediction after 只要 uses 不会 before 被. 没有 reports something that did not happen, and 别 is an order that cannot take 文件 as its subject.

s: 我的游戏机叫弟弟摔坏了。
s_py: wǒ de yóu xì jī jiào dì di shuāi huài le
zh: 我的游戏机叫弟弟摔坏了。
py: wǒ de yóu xì jī jiào dì di shuāi huài le
en: My game console was dropped and broken by my little brother.
why: 叫 + doer + verb with result is the spoken passive. The doer 弟弟 is stated, which 叫 requires.

zh: 我的流量让孩子用光了。
py: wǒ de liú liàng ràng hái zi yòng guāng le
en: My data was all used up by the kid.
why: 让 works like 被 here: receiver, 让, doer, then verb + result. 孩子 cannot go at the end.

q: 弟弟___我的眼镜弄丢了，我很生气。
zh: 弟弟把我的眼镜弄丢了，我很生气。
py: dì di bǎ wǒ de yǎn jìng nòng diū le wǒ hěn shēng qì
en: My little brother lost my glasses and I'm angry.
why: Here 弟弟 is the subject doing the losing, so the glasses are the 把 object. 被 would make the brother the thing that got lost.

q: 药已经___煎好了，快来喝吧。
zh: 药已经煎好了，快来喝吧。
py: yào yǐ jīng jiān hǎo le kuài lái hē ba
en: The medicine is already brewed, come and drink it.
why: A thing that cannot act is simply reported by its result, and nothing bad happened, so no 被. Adding 被 would suggest someone did something to it.

s_py: shǒu jī de diàn chōng mǎn le
zh: 手机的电充满了。
py: shǒu jī de diàn chōng mǎn le
en: The phone is fully charged.
why: A thing plus its result with no doer is the natural passive meaning. Adding 被 would not improve it.

s_py: yī shēng ràng wǒ duō hē shuǐ
zh: 医生让我多喝水。
py: yī shēng ràng wǒ duō hē shuǐ
en: The doctor told me to drink more water.
why: Here 让 means 'tell someone to', and the doctor is the subject. It is not a passive, so no result complement is needed.

s: 我的牙被他打掉了一颗。
s_py: wǒ de yá bèi tā dǎ diào le yì kē
zh: 我的牙被他打掉了一颗。
py: wǒ de yá bèi tā dǎ diào le yì kē
en: He knocked out one of my teeth.
why: A 被 sentence can keep a quantity after the verb. 掉 supplies the result, so the verb is not bare.

src: 饭被做好了。
src_py: fàn bèi zuò hǎo le
task: Say it naturally, with no 被.
zh: 饭做好了。
py: fàn zuò hǎo le
en: The meal is ready.
why: Food cannot cook itself and no doer is named, so the natural sentence is just thing + result + 了.

zh: 他的手机没被小偷偷走。
py: tā de shǒu jī méi bèi xiǎo tōu tōu zǒu
en: His phone wasn't stolen by a thief.
why: 没 negates the whole passive and goes right before 被. It cannot sit between 小偷 and 偷走, and there is no 了 at the end.

q: 我的充电器___小王拿走了，你有吗？
zh: 我的充电器叫小王拿走了，你有吗？
py: wǒ de chōng diàn qì jiào xiǎo wáng ná zǒu le nǐ yǒu ma
en: My charger was taken by Xiao Wang. Do you have one?
why: 叫 followed by the doer 小王 and a result 走 forms the spoken passive. 把 would make the charger the one taking, and 对 or 向 do not mark a doer.

src: 他的眼镜被同学踩坏了，他很生气。
src_py: tā de yǎn jìng bèi tóng xué cǎi huài le tā hěn shēng qì
task: Rewrite the first clause with 让.
zh: 他的眼镜让同学踩坏了他很生气。
py: tā de yǎn jìng ràng tóng xué cǎi huài le tā hěn shēng qì
en: His glasses were stepped on and broken by a classmate, and he was angry.
why: Replace 被 by 让 in the same position, keeping the doer 同学 and the result 踩坏了.

s_py: shǒu jī bèi tā bǎ shuāi huài le
zh: 手机被他摔坏了。
py: shǒu jī bèi tā shuāi huài le
en: The phone was dropped and broken by him.
why: Once the phone has moved to the front with 被, 把 has nothing left to take. 把 and 被 do not combine for one object.

src: 手机里的垃圾文件被他清理干净了。
src_py: shǒu jī lǐ de lā jī wén jiàn bèi tā qīng lǐ gān jìng le
zh: 他把手机里的垃圾文件清理干净了。
py: tā bǎ shǒu jī lǐ de lā jī wén jiàn qīng lǐ gān jìng le
en: He cleaned the junk files off his phone.
why: Move the doer 他 to the front and the receiver after 把; keep 清理干净了 unchanged.

src: 我的充电线被人拿走了。
src_py: wǒ de chōng diàn xiàn bèi rén ná zǒu le
zh: 我的充电线让人拿走了。
py: wǒ de chōng diàn xiàn ràng rén ná zǒu le
en: Someone took my charging cable.
why: 让 takes 被's place, and 人 must be kept as the doer because 让 cannot be followed straight by the verb.

s_py: wǒ de wén jiàn méi bèi shān chú le
zh: 我的文件没被删除。
py: wǒ de wén jiàn méi bèi shān chú
en: My file wasn't deleted.
why: 没 already says it did not happen, so the completion 了 cannot be added.

zh: 我们的聊天记录不会被别人看到的。
py: wǒ men de liáo tiān jì lù bù huì bèi bié rén kàn dào de
en: Other people won't see our chat history.
why: 不会 is a negative modal and so goes before 被. It cannot follow 别人 and sit before the verb.

q: 他的视频被同学传___网上了。
zh: 他的视频被同学传到网上了。
py: tā de shì pín bèi tóng xué chuán dào wǎng shàng le
en: His video was posted online by a classmate.
why: 到 + place after the verb says where the video ended up, which completes the 被 sentence. 传给网上 would mean 'give to the internet' and 着 or 过 give no destination.

src: 护士已经把药放进他的包里了。
src_py: hù shi yǐ jīng bǎ yào fàng jìn tā de bāo lǐ le
zh: 药已经被护士放进他的包里了。
py: yào yǐ jīng bèi hù shi fàng jìn tā de bāo lǐ le
en: The nurse has already put the medicine in his bag.
why: 已经 stays in front of the marker. The receiver 药 moves to the very front and 护士 follows 被.

src: 孩子把我的平板电脑摔得很碎。
src_py: hái zi bǎ wǒ de píng bǎn diàn nǎo shuāi de hěn suì
zh: 我的平板电脑被孩子摔得很碎。
py: wǒ de píng bǎn diàn nǎo bèi hái zi shuāi de hěn suì
en: The child dropped my tablet and it's smashed.
why: The 得 description after the verb is kept in the passive. The tablet goes first and 孩子 follows 被.

q: 他的手被门夹___了。
zh: 他的手被门夹伤了。
py: tā de shǒu bèi mén jiā shāng le
en: His hand got hurt when the door pinched it.
why: 夹 needs a result, and 伤 says what happened to the hand. 夹过了 would only mean it was pinched at some point, not that it was hurt.

q: 我的新手机___同学借走了。
zh: 我的新手机让同学借走了。
py: wǒ de xīn shǒu jī ràng tóng xué jiè zǒu le
en: My new phone was borrowed by a classmate.
why: Spoken Chinese can use 让 as the passive marker, with the doer 同学 right after it and a result 走 on the verb. 把 would make the phone do the borrowing.

zh: 我的照片被朋友发到网上了。
py: wǒ de zhào piàn bèi péng you fā dào wǎng shàng le
en: My photo was posted online by a friend.
why: 被 + 朋友 must precede the verb 发到; 到 + 网上 then says where it went. A 被 phrase after the verb is the English habit.

src: 弟弟喝完了我的牛奶。
src_py: dì di hē wán le wǒ de niú nǎi
task: Make 我的牛奶 the subject with 被.
zh: 我的牛奶被弟弟喝完了。
py: wǒ de niú nǎi bèi dì di hē wán le
en: My little brother drank up my milk.
why: The object moves to the front, 被 + doer goes before the verb, and 喝完了 keeps its result.

q: 我的饮料让___喝光了。
zh: 我的饮料让人喝光了。
py: wǒ de yǐn liào ràng rén hē guāng le
en: Someone drank up all my drink.
why: 让 as a passive marker must be followed by a doer, even if it is only 人 'someone'. With nothing after it, 让 has no one to be the doer.

src: 我的耳机被小偷偷了。
src_py: wǒ de ěr jī bèi xiǎo tōu tōu le
zh: 我的耳机被偷了。
py: wǒ de ěr jī bèi tōu le
en: My earphones were stolen.
why: With 被 the doer can simply be dropped, so the verb comes right after 被.

src: 妹妹把我的耳机弄丢了。
src_py: mèi mei bǎ wǒ de ěr jī nòng diū le
zh: 我的耳机被妹妹弄丢了。
py: wǒ de ěr jī bèi mèi mei nòng diū le
en: My little sister lost my earphones.
why: The 把 object becomes the subject, the 把 subject goes after 被, and 把 disappears.

q: 我的屏幕被弟弟摔___很碎。
zh: 我的屏幕被弟弟摔得很碎。
py: wǒ de píng mù bèi dì di shuāi de hěn suì
en: My little brother dropped my screen and it's all cracked.
why: To describe the state something was left in, add 得 after the verb. 地 goes before a verb and 的 before a noun.

src: 他把我气得说不出话来。
src_py: tā bǎ wǒ qì de shuō bù chū huà lái
zh: 我被他气得说不出话来。
py: wǒ bèi tā qì de shuō bù chū huà lái
en: He made me so angry I couldn't speak.
why: The 得 description is kept. The object 我 moves to the front and the doer 他 follows 被.

q: 放心，你的照片___会被别人看到的。
zh: 放心，你的照片不会被别人看到的。
py: fàng xīn nǐ de zhào piàn bù huì bèi bié rén kàn dào de
en: Relax, other people won't see your photos.
why: A prediction is negated with 不会, and it comes before 被. 没 is for past events and 别 is a command, so neither fits with 会.

q: 我的充电线被猫___咬坏了。
zh: 我的充电线被猫咬坏了。
py: wǒ de chōng diàn xiàn bèi māo yǎo huài le
en: My charging cable got chewed up by the cat.
why: Once the object has moved to the front with 被, nothing is left for 把 to do. 把 and 被 never both appear for the same object.

s_py: wǒ de zhào piàn bèi méi shān chú
zh: 我的照片没被删除。
py: wǒ de zhào piàn méi bèi shān chú
en: My photos weren't deleted.
why: 没 goes before 被, not between 被 and the verb.

src: 他没把我的手机弄坏。
src_py: tā méi bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī nòng huài
zh: 我的手机没被他弄坏。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī méi bèi tā nòng huài
en: He didn't break my phone.
why: The negative stays in front of the marker, now 被, and the final verb phrase is unchanged with no 了 added.

q: 他被救护车送___医院，医生马上给他做了检查。
zh: 他被救护车送到医院，医生马上给他做了检查。
py: tā bèi jiù hù chē sòng dào yī yuàn yī shēng mǎ shàng gěi tā zuò le jiǎn chá
en: He was taken to the hospital by ambulance, and the doctor examined him right away.
why: 到 + place states where he was taken, which completes the verb. 送给医院 would mean giving him to the hospital as a present.

zh: 你的体检报告已经出来了。
py: nǐ de tǐ jiǎn bào gào yǐ jīng chū lái le
en: Your checkup report is already out.
why: The report is a thing and nobody did anything to it in this sentence, so there is no 被. 被出来 is not a possible phrase.
